comparison.objective: Remove a selected midget fuse from spring clips with a tong puller and tray it.
comparison.physical_skill: Confined-access tool alignment, opposed-jaw grasping, and clip extraction.
comparison.success_condition: F2 fully removed with the puller, released still in tray, puller put down; F1/F3 remain seated.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained extraction rather than orientation-dependent granular separation.
